source.scope: One saved level-12 player versus CHR-defined snow monster with one fixed learned action; this is not the actual forest encounter group.

order.selector_reachable_conditions: 0x5036D0 allows loaded, alive, enabled, delay-zero actors whose gauges reach the threshold; with both sides ready and initial side preference 0 a queued player can precede an enemy.
order.original_scheduler: 0x502F30 updates gauges and delay; 0x5036D0 chooses highest eligible gauge and alternates preferred side when multiple actors are ready. The complete live gauge scheduler is not integrated.

enemy_selection.policy: fixed skill index 14 for this controlled test
enemy_selection.original_policy: 0x5029A0 includes weighted skills and a random combo branch; no claim that native AI always chooses this skill.

world_mapping.policy: World current HP/MP are stored raw uint32 bit patterns; battle resources add recovered linked equipment bonuses. Signed raw HP is represented as uint32 on world commit and decoded with |0 on re-entry.
world_mapping.limits: Fixture only accepts the verified player level, attribute ranges, stored maxima and historical source fingerprint; fresh battle statuses and stance are controlled.

limitations: Native gauge timing, complete AI, combo selection, encounter loading, rewards and new-game initialization remain outside this slice.
Source CHR 001 defaults are level 11; player battle values instead follow the level-12 saved header and equipped item instances.
No original battle was executed; all tests are reconstruction tests.
